run_rerank_score_bw_cli: run the rerank_score_bw CLI to score translations using backwards rescoring with fairseq
run_score_bw_function: run the score_bw function to score hypothesis translations for model 1 and model 2
run_backwards_rescoring: run backwards rescoring on MT hypotheses by swapping source and target language directions
run_dual_model_scoring: run scoring of translations with two separate models using the rerank_score_bw CLI tool
run_score_reference_generation: run reference scoring with batch size 128 using the fairseq generate main function
